task.spec: Read the manager note and classify its main subject as exactly one of 'billing', 'technical', 'account' or 'shipping'. Return only that label.

Split the input text into lines. For each line, split on ' | ' into exactly four fields: name, date, hours, and project. Convert hours to a number. Return a list of four-element lists in the same order as the input.
Sum the hours field across all records and return the numeric sum.
Group records by name and sum each person's hours. Return a list of [name, total_hours] pairs, one per person, in any order.
From the [name, total_hours] pairs, return the name with the greatest total; if totals tie, return the alphabetically first name. Return 'none' if the list is empty.
Group records by the pair (name, date) and sum the hours for each pair. Return a list of [name, date, total_hours] lists, one per distinct pair.
Count the daily-hours entries whose total_hours is strictly greater than 8, and return that count.
Count the distinct project values appearing in the records and return that count.
Format and return exactly '<topic>: <total>h total, top <person>, <overtime> overtime days, <projects> projects'. Format total with exactly one digit after the decimal point.
